## What's Changed
* Update readme by @robflop in https://github.com/LISTEN-moe/desktop-app/pull/40
* feat: igpu rewrite by @Pitu in https://github.com/LISTEN-moe/desktop-app/pull/58


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LISTEN-moe/desktop-app/compare/0.3.1...1.0.0

- Implement check for updates (1ac78e29ba66f4af2c7ed6a51114cef2e2197aab)
- Add context menu toggle for stay on top (d11eefb2ffb29b3e9141c204bc3bb40ca285b9ff)
- Windows media control via media session API (202058f5765081307a6151a313a53b84a11dd7df)

- Add favorite/unfavorite toggle to tray (8356c94bc4cfd355fb3b59b7af3a4d26a7fb5ddb)
- Add support for displaying character songs (9a8ce91b34d391d1545efe44dfe84f35e6007e33)
- Fixed issue when text would become selected when trying to drag the window (b09f4da3479fa5678986946fd2291b2a9fc62c77)

* Correctly show colors and info for kpop radio (9921bca3e565462e40f28bea966a7946130cefd2)
* Toggle play/pause from tray icon (9921bca3e565462e40f28bea966a7946130cefd2)
* Added ability to minimize to tray (b18980ded021b36243a1b20767a53f64a9f44283)
* Fixed icons on macOS and linux (b18980ded021b36243a1b20767a53f64a9f44283)
- Remove erroneous dependency to build on windows (c55fe5688e0a5037a9aaf0b8244d9b43627f08dc)
Dummy release because windows version wouldn't build in the last release.

- Upgraded to electron 6
- Fixed GraphQL cors error

- Upgraded to electron 5
- Fixed WebSocket reconnecting issues
- Fixed an issue that prevented tray icon to display when logged out
